minutes.headline: Planning Board continued all open hearings to January 13 and assigned peer reviews for two new common-driveway applications.
minutes.summary: The board continued hearings for 494 Electric Ave, the three Leominster Road/Kilburn Street applications, 558/560 Goodridge Street and 171 Arbor Street to January 13, mostly awaiting peer review from Graves Engineering and Town Counsel. It voted peer reviews for the two new common-driveway applications, released a performance guarantee for 512 Northfield Road, and discussed the Master Plan Steering Committee's quorum problems and upcoming zoning updates (ADU, flood maps, MBTA).

public_comment.topic: Thanked applicant for drainage fix at 15 Kirby but said water now runs into the parking lot and onward; raised serious flooding downhill.
Said the board has a moral obligation to help the 494 Electric Ave business since the earlier tent-to-building approval contributed to the problem.
Supported the common driveway to preserve a house lot for one of his children.
Concerned that stormwater running to the rear wetland of the former gravel pit at 171 Arbor Street would affect his farm and horse land.

budget_items.what_was_said: Staff recommended a peer review amount to cover Graves Engineering review of the common driveway and stormwater.
A member moved peer review by Graves Engineering with a cap.
Land use director confirmed vegetation survived the six-month period and recommended releasing the bond.
The town requested money for the regional planning commission to consult on MBTA Communities zoning; it is advisory and does not bind the town.

decisions.decision: For January 13 the 494 Electric Ave applicant is to bring a full revised plan set incorporating town, peer review and public comments.
Staff suggested that if Town Counsel has not responded on Pierce Avenue by end of week, the board proceed on the applicant's position; the land use director will speak with counsel Wednesday.
Master Plan Steering Committee composition (quorum, possible non-voting members, officers) deferred to the January 13 meeting when Mr Wilner can attend.
Meeting dates noted: January 13, January 27 and February 10; no December 23 meeting.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the hearings for 494 Electric Ave, the Leominster Road and Kilburn Street applications, 558/560 Goodridge Street and 171 Arbor Street to January 13.
The board assigned Graves Engineering as peer reviewer, with a cap, for the common driveway and stormwater applications at 558/560 Goodridge Street and 171 Arbor Street.
The board moved to release the performance guarantee for 512 Northfield Road after staff said the vegetation survived the six-month period; the vote outcome is not audible.
The Master Plan Steering Committee's composition and quorum were deferred to January 13, when a member who was absent can attend.
The applicant at 494 Electric Ave is to bring a full revised plan set reflecting town, peer review and public comments.

why_it_matters: Several development applications, including two common driveways with stormwater questions raised by neighbors, stay open until at least January 13, so abutters can still comment.
Peer-review fees on the two new applications are capped, and the performance guarantee release shows the board's process for returning a bond after an approved project is checked.
watch_next: January 13 Planning Board meeting at 6:05 p.m., when the continued hearings resume and the Master Plan Steering Committee's composition is taken up.
Graves Engineering's peer review reports on 558/560 Goodridge Street and 171 Arbor Street, and Town Counsel's response on Pierce Avenue.

reconciliation.summary: The records agree on every non-procedural vote, the $3,000 and $6,000 amounts and the $20,000 figure. Differences are misheard names (Goodridge, McLoud, Reed, Wilner) and the vote outcomes ours could not hear. The one substantive difference is the Master Plan Steering Committee: ours records a deferral to Jan 13, the official records a research assignment; the 1260 Reservoir Rd endorsement is also only in the official record.
